_comment: HLD test 18 throughput baseline. CI gate fires if measured throughput < threshold_pct * baseline. Update manually when an intentional perf change lands; do NOT auto-update (silent baseline drift defeats the gate's purpose).
_calibration_notes: Initial baseline measured 2026-05-10 on GitHub `ubuntu-latest` runner: 31.9M genotypes/sec end-to-end (pass-1 alignment + pass-2 genotype rewrite + .psam finalization) on a 250-sample × 20K-variant × 2-panel fixture. The HLD §Performance 100M g/s target was aspirational and assumed dedicated developer hardware + raw pgenlib throughput excluding pandas/IO overhead. The 25M baseline below is set conservatively below the measured 31.9M to leave noise margin on shared CI runners; the 80% threshold then effectively gates at ~20M g/s, which catches a real >40% regression without tripping on day-to-day GitHub-runner variance.
